definitions.gloss: school attendance; entering school; enrollment in school
definitions.explanation: The act of attending or enrolling in school, especially compulsory education.

examples.japanese: {就学|しゅうがく}{前|まえ}の{子供|こども}には{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Children need vaccinations before starting school.

examples.japanese: {義務|ぎむ}{教育|きょういく}の{就学|しゅうがく}{率|りつ}はほぼ100%だ。
examples.english: The school enrollment rate for compulsory education is nearly 100%.

examples.japanese: {就学|しゅうがく}{届|とどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the school enrollment notification.

notes:
KANJI:
{就|しゅう} (to take up) + {学|がく} (learning)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{就学|しゅうがく}{前|まえ} - pre-school age
・{就学|しゅうがく}{児童|じどう} - school-age child
・{就学|しゅうがく}{率|りつ} - enrollment rate
・{就学|しゅうがく}{届|とどけ} - enrollment notification
・{就学|しゅうがく}{猶予|ゆうよ} - deferment of school enrollment

RELATED TERMS:
・{入学|にゅうがく} - entering (a specific) school
・{通学|つうがく} - commuting to school
・{修学|しゅうがく} - pursuit of learning (note: different kanji)
